channel.title: The Drill Down: Green Bay Packers
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Packers at Rams
item.description: Wed 11/25 · 8:00 PM ET | Line: LA -2.5 · O/U 43.5 | Model LA 70% vs. market 55% | Green Bay's pass rush has to beat the Rams' second-ranked pass protection, because a unit that generates pressure on 21% of dropbacks cannot count on Stafford being rattled. Matthew Golden soaks up 29% of Green Bay's targets and runs into a Rams pass defense ranked 8th, so Love's throws to him will decide whether Green Bay keeps pace. Our model gives the Rams 70% against a market price of 55%, with the rushing matchup doing most of the work.

item.title: Week 10: Vikings at Packers
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: GB -2.5 · O/U 42.5 | Model GB 72% vs. market 57% | The game turns on whether Minnesota's front can reach Jordan Love, since Minnesota's 25% pressure rate ranks first and Green Bay's offense ranks fourth in EPA per dropback. Matthew Golden absorbs 29% of Green Bay's targets, and he runs into a Minnesota pass defense ranked third. Our model has Green Bay at 72% against a market number of 57%, driven mostly by the passing matchup.
